g.text: Local application on one computer. D1 is a combined logical store.
Main requirements: FR-06, FR-14, FR-15, FR-17, NFR-03.
[Not logged in OR not a current group member]
Do not store or distribute the message.
[Logged in AND a current group member]
Recipient filtering also checks login and current membership.
Other users and former members receive no group content.
Delivery transport and repeated requests are omitted at this level.
Accepted does not mean read. Offline delivery is unresolved (IA03 Q-03).
Timing and reliability targets still require testing.
